{{Dialogue|Bozzie|Who did that?|Wicket Wystri Warrick|I'm sorry, Aunt Bozzie. It was just a&mdash;|Paploo|It was a giant flock of mudslinging thunder bats.|attr=Bozzie, Wicket Wystri Warrick, and Paploo|audio=Thunderbats-CriesoftheTrees.flac|src=<ref name="Cries of the Trees" />}}
'''Thunder bats''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Bat/Legends|bat]] that could be found on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="Cries of the Trees" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="EwoksDate">{{EwoksDate|mention of thunder [[Bat/Legends|bats]]|[[The Cries of the Trees]]}}</ref> the Endor-residing [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]] and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] were playing [[drop-the-sack]], attempting to drop a sack of mud on their friend [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]]. When Warrick accidentally hit his [[Gender/Legends|aunt]] [[Bozzie]] instead of Teebo, Paploo told Bozzie that the mud had been thrown by a giant flock of thunder bats.<ref name="Cries of the Trees" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thunder bats were first mentioned in "[[The Cries of the Trees]],"<ref name="Cries of the Trees" /> the pilot episode of the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]. The episode was written by [[Paul Dini]] and premiered on [[September 7]], [[1985]].<ref name="Insider 27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
